evidence: Both complete FP32 direct-mixture diagnostics fail large-step behavior. Exact densities improve seed42 copying but worsen seed43, still miss truncation and length. Base/warm scoring drift zero.
decision: Stop incremental proposal expansion for large-step reliability. Develop pre-update autoregressive logit-tangent sampling rather than reweighting a fixed proposal bank.
hypothesis: A first-order parameter-logit model evaluated along its own sampled prefixes may represent emerging truncation and formatting events absent from baseline proposals. It can still fail due to curvature and distribution drift.
implementation_check: First assess forward-mode JVP feasibility on training-only inputs, finite-difference derivative agreement, zero-direction and restoration checks, then freeze a separately specified bounded development phase. No direct updated-logit oracle counted as prospective forecasting.
limitations: Data and checkpoint seeds reused development; standard neural-network linearization is not novel; method may cost more than simply evaluating an actual update. Need honest cost comparison and gradient-compression baselines.
